Embedded instrumentation & electrical measurements · 2026

Pico 2 W EE Lab Tool

How can a compact bench tool measure real circuits and make the limits of each reading visible?

Built
Five operating modes on a Pico 2 W, with an INA219, OLED display, Wi-Fi dashboard, and experiment logging.
Evidence
The integrated prototype was verified on hardware. Documented RC time constants are 1.076–1.079 s, with calibrated voltage and independently checked shunt current.
Boundary
The latest Source Test guard and replacement OLED driver still need device rechecks. Fault monitoring reports conditions; it does not disconnect power.
Project context

A hands-on electrical engineering tool that connects circuit theory, sensor calibration, firmware, and measurement integrity.

MicroPythonEmbedded systemsCircuit measurementsHardware validation

Completed · Tested

Electrical measurements · 2026

Power Quality Lab

How can sampled AC waveforms reveal power-quality problems?

Built
A Python waveform lab for RMS, power factor, frequency, sag, swell, and no-load classification.
Evidence
Deterministic synthetic waveforms, explicit classification thresholds, and a public unittest suite.
Boundary
Simulation only. ADC quantization, isolation, harmonics, calibration drift, and electrical safety are not modeled.
Project context

It turns sampled voltage and current into reproducible engineering evidence while documenting the gap between simulation and a safe, calibrated physical instrument.

Electrical measurementsSignal processingPythonAutomated testing

Power systems & controls · 2026

Microgrid Controller Simulation

How should a microgrid serve demand when solar, battery, and grid power have limits?

Built
A deterministic dispatch controller with state-of-charge, battery-power, outage, and grid-import constraints.
Evidence
A unittest suite and inspectable dispatch decisions with explicit energy-balance error and unserved load.
Boundary
Supervisory simulation only. Voltage dynamics, reactive power, protection, thermal behavior, and communications delay are omitted.
Project context

It makes each dispatch decision inspectable and reports unserved load instead of hiding an impossible energy balance.

Power systemsControlsEnergy constraintsPython simulation

Completed · Tested

Embedded networks & security · 2026

CAN Bus Anomaly Lab

How can unusual CAN traffic be explained through inspectable rules?

Built
A defensive traffic simulator and rule engine for identifiers, timing, payload ranges, and rolling counters.
Evidence
Synthetic benign and anomalous traffic, explainable rule findings, and a public unittest suite.
Boundary
No physical CAN connection. Static rules can miss slow or context-dependent attacks and need system-specific calibration.
Project context

It demonstrates transparent embedded-network monitoring without transmitting frames or connecting to a safety-critical system.

Computer engineeringCAN busDefensive cybersecurityAutomated testing

Completed · Tested

Responsible AI & backend systems · 2026

Trailhead Customer Support API

How can a support assistant help without inventing policy or business authority?

Built
A FastAPI service combining Claude conversation, policy retrieval, deterministic tools, and structured escalation.
Evidence
Tests mock Claude; CI runs the test suite and Ruff. Responses expose citations, tool use, and escalation decisions.
Boundary
Read-only fictional business demo. Customer email is a demo authentication stand-in; no refund or cancellation is actually performed.
Project context

My role: System architecture, backend implementation, policy grounding, and validation

It demonstrates how model-driven conversation can stay bounded by tested authorization, business rules, citations, and clear production-safety limits.
